name: THE VELVET CREEPERS – NOCTURNE
description: THE VELVET CREEPERS, a queer cabaret group, presents NOCTURNE: A circus for creatures who only exist after dark. This unique show delivers a journey into Berlin's diverse performance culture, past and present, combining burlesque, cabaret, and circus with extraordinary performers. A tribute to Berlin's performance history and its dynamic community, featuring passion and inspiration characteristic of the city's creative scene.
